correctness.rationale: Exact two-jump generator verified by physical exhaustive edge orders and independent rational moment recurrence. The fluid ODE conserves h=ae^(-b/a), stays above positive r, and its BB reaction makes A-B nondecreasing. Uniform finite-horizon fluid approximation plus late separation ensures B exhausts with high probability. The generator drift of h is O(1/N), the extinction time O_p(log N), and the squared-jump bracket has deterministic limit Q=e^(-2b/a)(b^3/a+2b^2). The tail bracket vanishes by E integral b <= b(T)/c and finite jump sizes satisfy martingale CLT Lindeberg conditions. Substituting b=a log(a/r) yields explicit strictly positive v. Exact finite moment tests and variance quadrature passed; finite data are not used as proof of the limit.

value.rationale: Complete split graphs are a canonical dense inhomogeneous substrate whose independent vertices may be abandoned despite perfect-matching feasibility. The exact terminal central limit theorem gives the natural finite-size fluctuation scale and a nontrivial closed variance beyond the first-order mean-field jamming density, with potential use in assessing kinetic matching variability. The model is neither an arbitrary slice nor just an algebraic reformulation of prior bipartite defect laws.
